title: Whose Charges at the Property the Credit on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation May Meet
content:
Which counted charges taken at the property make up the eligible spend on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on how widely those charges are spread across the occupants of the room and on how the adults declared compare with the rooms held.

## The rule

1. Where counted charges taken at the property stand against more than one occupant of the room and the reservation declares more adults than the rooms held, the eligible spend is every counted charge taken at the property, whoever took it.
2. Where counted charges taken at the property stand against more than one occupant of the room and the reservation declares no more adults than the rooms held, the eligible spend is only the counted charges standing against the lead guest's own occupant sequence, which is the first.
3. In every other case the eligible spend is nothing.

Charges stand against more than one occupant where the occupant sequence those charges reach is above 1. A reservation declares more adults than the rooms held where the adults declared stand strictly above the number of rooms.

## The combinations

| Counted charges stand against | Adults declared against the rooms held | Eligible spend |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than one occupant | more adults than rooms | every counted charge, whoever took it |
| more than one occupant | no more adults than rooms | only the counted charges standing against the lead guest |
| one occupant at most | more adults than rooms | nothing |
| one occupant at most | no more adults than rooms | nothing |

Where the charges stand against one occupant at most, the eligible spend is nothing however the party is made up.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A reservation holding 2 rooms, whose counted charges taken at the property come to 85.00 USD in all, of which 35.00 USD stands against the lead guest, and whose charges reach an occupant sequence of 3:

- With 4 adults declared, more than the 2 rooms held, the eligible spend is 85.00 USD.
- With 2 adults declared, no more than the 2 rooms held, the eligible spend is 35.00 USD.
- Where the charges reached an occupant sequence of 1, the eligible spend would be 0.00 USD in either case.
